name: How long does deck lighting installation typically take?
description: Installation time varies by design complexity, lighting type, and deck size, from one day for simple projects to several for complex wiring.

mainEntity.name: How long does deck lighting installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck lighting installation varies depending on the complexity of the design, the type of lighting chosen, and the size of the deck. A simple installation might take a day, while more intricate designs with extensive wiring could take several days. We provide a detailed project timeline after assessing your deck and lighting plan, helping you understand the process and expected completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by design complexity, lighting type, and deck size, from one day for simple projects to several for complex wiring.
